executive_summary: The run closes at publishable-pending-owner-approval: every item in the frontier carries a current verdict for the frozen content, the entire judge-rejection set was adjudicated, the proof-layout gates pass on the current manifests, and nothing is deferred or left as an open pathway obligation. Read as a whole, the defect history is dominated by failures of precision rather than fabrication — missing hypotheses, unlicensed or unsupported inferences, missing choice scope, and ill-typed claims or constructions — each found and dispositioned by the run's own review and adjudication; the confirmed-fatal findings are all recorded as repaired, one published claim was deliberately narrowed instead, and one recorded finding was overturned as a false positive. Mathematical closure therefore rests on process evidence bound to a specific content state, not on a fresh independent audit, and the caveats below say where that closure should be probed: the narrowed claim and its consumers, the clusters where repairs were blocked or repeated, the historical notes that still read as escalations, and the fact that a fully judged verdict set is consistency rather than certainty.
caveats: Closure is process evidence, not a fresh proofread. The verdict rests on the run's own review, adjudication, judging and repair records over one frozen content state; a complete and closed verdict set means every version was judged and every rejection resolved, not that every proof is correct. The owner's personal mathematical audit is the remaining independent check, and the reading priorities below are sampling guidance for it, not a substitute.

The packet's defect notes are historical, captured before their fixes, and several still read as open escalations — for example the rational-homotopy citation locators, the parametric-lifting and thickening chain, the Schubert characteristic-ball proof, and a mis-escaped TeX display — even though the corresponding rows are dispositioned as fixed. I spot-checked representative current items and found them consistent with the dispositions, but the packet carries no per-note post-fix re-verification trace, so unaudited rows cannot be wholly excluded.

One published claim was deliberately weakened rather than repaired: the former unrestricted genuine restriction-fibration statement in lem-restriction-of-formal-immersion-data-has-the-parametric-lifting-property is now a dimension-qualified interface with an explicit counterexample qualification. Its consumers — lem-parametric-immersion-extension-on-a-disk, lem-formal-immersion-homotopies-extend-over-a-subcritical-handle, and the page formal-immersions-and-the-smale-hirsch-theorem — are the places where a stale expectation of the withdrawn stronger claim could still hide.

Risk is concentrated where repair was hard or repeated. The ledger records a connected block of repairs whose cost was originally recorded as blocked and later fixed, items repaired more than once (one item three times), and repeated fatal rows on the same subjects; those signals are the basis for the reading priorities, and they are the most likely places for residual seams.

Judge evidence is consistency within one configured set of verdicts, not independent corroboration: the run resolved every version to a single outcome with no mixed verdicts, and a few rejections were overturned as false positives, so the judging step errs in both directions. Completeness of coverage should not be read as mathematical certainty.

The evidence is bound to one exact content state: the readiness content hash, the proof-layout fingerprint and the recorded input hashes all describe the same frozen snapshot. Any edit afterwards — even a formatting pass — invalidates the layout gates and the verdict records for the changed items, so approval, if given, should name that state.

Nothing is deferred and no pathway obligation remains open, so there is no parked list to absorb residual doubt: a claim that is still wrong would surface only through the owner's audit or as a post-publication correction, and any correction must be routed through the published-defect ledger with fresh certification.

Coverage is weighted towards differential topology, with smaller homological-algebra and algebraic-topology components, and the reading priorities follow that weight; the owner's audit plan should do the same rather than sampling uniformly across kinds. Page prose and summaries are part of the reader-facing surface and were themselves repaired, so the audit should include pages, not only item bodies.

owner_reading_priorities.subject: lem-restriction-of-formal-immersion-data-has-the-parametric-lifting-property — the run's one narrowed claim
owner_reading_priorities.reason: The claim itself changed: the former unrestricted genuine restriction fibration is now a dimension-qualified interface with an explicit counterexample qualification. Confirm the narrowed statement is what should be published, and check that its consumers (lem-parametric-immersion-extension-on-a-disk, lem-formal-immersion-homotopies-extend-over-a-subcritical-handle, and the page formal-immersions-and-the-smale-hirsch-theorem) assert only what it still supplies.

owner_reading_priorities.subject: Morse–Smale continuation, Morse homology and handle-cancellation cluster
owner_reading_priorities.reason: The largest connected block of repairs that were initially recorded as blocked sits here — invalid inferences across continuation data, chain maps, compactified moduli and the Morse-homology comparison — and several members were then repaired again, including thm-homotopic-continuation-data-give-chain-homotopic-maps, def-canonical-morse-homology-of-a-closed-manifold and lem-compactified-unstable-manifolds-give-a-cw-decomposition. Blocked-then-repaired proofs are where seams most plausibly remain.

owner_reading_priorities.subject: Parametric immersion and Smale–Hirsch extensibility chain
owner_reading_priorities.reason: Repairs at owner stage and adjudication stage touched def-compact-parameter-pair, the smoothing and weak-topology family lemmas, lem-parametric-immersion-extension-on-a-disk and thm-smale-hirsch-for-open-source-manifolds, changing hypotheses and choice scope; the owner should trace the corrected hypotheses through to the closed-source theorem they underwrite, including the compact-parameter and free/proper clauses.

owner_reading_priorities.subject: Foliations, holonomy and Godbillon–Vey material, including its two pages
owner_reading_priorities.reason: This is the densest single-topic set of confirmed-fatal findings, spanning the holonomy-representation definition, C1 regularity and compact-leaf lemmas, characteristic disks and annuli, polycycle rounding and the Reeb-component propositions; rem-compact-leaf-does-not-mean-finite-holonomy-or-finite-fundamental-group is also the only item recorded as repaired three times.

owner_reading_priorities.subject: Whitney trick, Whitney disks and surgery cluster
owner_reading_priorities.reason: One lemma (lem-fundamental-group-label-is-the-obstruction-to-contracting-the-whitney-circle) accumulated an unusually large share of the fatal rows, and the surrounding Whitney-disk, embedded-band, handle-slide, surgery-gluing and dual-surgery items were repeatedly repaired. This chain underpins the high-dimensional Poincaré, h-cobordism and embedding statements, so local errors would propagate widely.

owner_reading_priorities.subject: Handle theory and h-cobordism definitions and main theorems
owner_reading_priorities.reason: Several definitions and core theorems here were repaired more than once — def-smooth-cobordism-triad-for-morse-theory, lem-interior-slab-handle-attachment, lem-handles-of-equal-index-can-be-attached-on-one-level, thm-morse-rearrangement-by-index and prop-h-cobordisms-admit-adapted-ordered-handle-decompositions among them. Because changed definitions invalidate dependent proofs, read the final statements before their consequences.

owner_reading_priorities.subject: Pontryagin–Thom correspondence, Thom prespectrum and Euler-class chain, including its pages
owner_reading_priorities.reason: The correspondence chain received statement-level fatal repairs (def-thom-prespectrum-of-the-universal-real-and-oriented-bundles, def-framed-regular-preimage-of-a-map-to-a-sphere, thm-pontryagin-thom-correspondence-in-fixed-codimension) and its pages had prose defects; pages are the reader-facing surface, so their repaired summaries deserve a direct read.

owner_reading_priorities.subject: Homological-algebra material: Eilenberg–Watts, Morita and finite-category pages and items
owner_reading_priorities.reason: Page-level defects concentrate on morita-bicategories-and-projective-generators and deligne-products-and-categorical-eilenberg-watts, and many items in this family churned repeatedly (pseudofunctor interchange, finite right-exact functors, graded shifts, finite tensor categories). Categorical equivalences are easy to overstate in summaries, so page prose is the priority here.

owner_reading_priorities.subject: Lefschetz number, fixed-point index and vector-field index cluster
owner_reading_priorities.reason: def-local-fixed-point-index, def-isolated-zero-and-local-index-of-a-vector-field, lem-vector-field-index-is-independent-of-chart-ball-and-trivialization and ex-degree-d-map-on-a-sphere-has-lefschetz-number-one-plus-minus-d each carried multiple fatal rows, including definitions other items depend on; check the index normalization, sign and independence claims as a unit.

recommendations.recommendation: Run the personal mathematical audit as a targeted sample along the reading priorities — starting with the narrowed claim, the blocked-then-repaired Morse–Smale block and the foliation cluster — rather than attempting a uniform re-read of the whole frontier.
recommendations.impact: Concentrates the remaining independent check where the ledger itself records the greatest repair difficulty, which is the cheapest credible path to catch residual errors before publication.
recommendations.evidence: The packet's fatal rows contain a connected set whose repair cost was recorded as blocked, repeated repairs on the same items (one item three times), and repeated fatal rows on the same subjects; those are the signals the priorities are built from.

recommendations.recommendation: Verify directly the current text of the items whose retained notes still read as open escalations — the rational-homotopy citation locators, the batch-20 parametric-lifting and thickening chain, the Schubert characteristic-ball proof, and the mis-escaped TeX display — because the notes predate the recorded fixes.
recommendations.impact: Closes the only gap where the packet's narrative could disagree with its own closed dispositions before the owner approves publication.
recommendations.evidence: My representative spot checks matched the fixed dispositions (corrected locators in the rational-homotopy frontmatter, the narrowed statement with its Qualification, the rewritten Schubert proof, and no remaining mis-escaped display in items), but there is no per-note closure trace for the rest.

recommendations.recommendation: Before accepting the Smale–Hirsch route, check that every consumer of the narrowed parametric-lifting interface asserts only the dimension-qualified case now proved, namely lem-parametric-immersion-extension-on-a-disk, lem-formal-immersion-homotopies-extend-over-a-subcritical-handle and the page formal-immersions-and-the-smale-hirsch-theorem.
recommendations.impact: A consumer still written against the withdrawn unrestricted genuine statement would be a published overclaim even though every recorded row is closed.
recommendations.evidence: The narrowing disposition and the current Qualification section in the item; a repository search shows those three are the complete set of item and page references to the interface.

recommendations.recommendation: Make the deliberate status changes only against the frozen content state, and re-run the layout and judge evidence for any item touched after approval.
recommendations.impact: Keeps the published text and the evidence that supports it in exact correspondence, since the closure is bound to one content hash and one layout fingerprint.
recommendations.evidence: The packet records a content hash for readiness, a proof-layout fingerprint, and exact input hashes — all describing a single snapshot that later edits would invalidate.

recommendations.recommendation: Route any post-publication correction through the published-defect ledger and a fresh certification pass rather than direct edits, and keep this report's caveats with the run record.
recommendations.impact: Preserves the audit trail and prevents the silent divergence between item text, manifests and verdict evidence that this run repeatedly had to repair.
recommendations.evidence: The ledger contains contract-sync, manifest and frontmatter defect rows where metadata lagged or contradicted the item text, so unsynchronised updates are a demonstrated failure mode here.

recommendations.recommendation: Record explicitly that closure rests on the configured judge set's verdicts over the frozen content, with no independent second set, one narrowed claim, and no deferrals, so future maintainers read the verdict honestly.
recommendations.impact: Prevents a complete verdict set from being mistaken for independent mathematical certification, and tells maintainers exactly what the owner audited personally.
recommendations.evidence: The verification block shows one verdict per judged version within the configured set with no mixed outcomes, and the readiness block still lists the personal mathematical audit as an owner action.
